theme_title: RIL Q2 Results Preview: Profit outlook brightens as O2C business set to drive growth
summary: Reliance Industries is expected to report 15-17% year-on-year growth in September-quarter EBITDA, driven by a sharp recovery in its oil-to-chemicals business.
